commons-exports-check.desc:
Verifies that every module declared in the root `mod.rs` of every `t/` and `s/` commons directory (see import-rules check) is: - private (i.e. `mod x;`, never `pub mod x;`); and - is glob re-exported (i.e. `pub use x::*;`).
TODO: I think this has to be every `mod.rs` file in the directories, not just the root.
commons-exports-check.rationale: So that users can import `use ...::t::TypeName` (i.e. not `use ...::t::submodule::TypeName`), saving character.
commons-exports-check.exception: The glob re-export is not required when the module exposes no public items to re-export (e.g. a module containing only `impl` blocks).
